paper.title: Wind Farm Power Production in the Changing Wind: Robustness Quantification and Layout Optimization
paper.authors: Ju Feng and Wen Zhong Shen

public_source_search.target_result: DTU Orbit provides the accepted manuscript; no paper-linked implementation or numerical archive was located.

same_lineage_source.use: Horns Rev 1 coordinates and Vestas V80 tables

semantic_contract.decision_variables: continuous x,y coordinates for 80 identical V80-2MW turbines
semantic_contract.constraints: T60 Horns parallelogram and pairwise Euclidean distance at least 5D=400m
semantic_contract.wake_and_power: cited T60 Jensen expansion, partial overlap, RSS deficits and pinned V80 power/Ct curves
semantic_contract.wind: target-cited three-year hub-height Table-1 parameters, 12-sector piecewise joint PDF, 360 directions and integer speeds 3..25m/s
semantic_contract.short_metric: paper normalized 8-neighbor PSRI and literal Eq.4/6 VoP quadrature
semantic_contract.long_metric: 1000 common lambda=1 Monte Carlo distributions with maximal A,c,f variations 0.2,0.1,0.5 and normalized frequencies
semantic_contract.objectives: five alpha short, five beta long and five gamma overall robustness cases
semantic_contract.optimizer: single incumbent; uniformly select a turbine and a random feasible position; strictly improving feasible trial commits
semantic_contract.physical_fes: one complete feasible layout robustness evaluation, including initial layout; 10000 per paper case
semantic_contract.repeats: one run per reported weight because the paper states no independent repeat count
